cases.input: Deliver an approved single-video learning-content-model as HTML, PPTX, DOCX and PDF using the active corporate design, preserving the same claims and source traceability across formats.
requiredBehaviors: lock one canonical content model before rendering
route each requested format to its specialized producer and preserve producer ownership
run cross-format QA and record the actual delivery bundle and run status
forbiddenBehaviors: claim worker-owned HTML PPTX DOCX PDF or asset files as learning-delivery-workflow outputs

cases.input: A course delivery requests HTML and PDF only; one optional illustration fails, but the content remains understandable without it and all required source-linked diagrams render correctly.
requiredBehaviors: skip unrequested formats rather than generating them implicitly
document the optional asset failure and continue only when it is semantically dispensable
keep the final status evidence-based on actual render and QA coverage
forbiddenBehaviors: mark an unrendered format as delivered
hide a failed asset or fabricate a replacement artifact
skillAnchors: Nicht angeforderte Formate müssen nicht erzeugt werden
wenn semantisch verzichtbar, dokumentiert ohne Asset fortfahren
ein visueller PASS wird nur bei tatsächlich geprüften Rendern vergeben

cases.input: Two conflicting learning models are supplied without an authority decision. The proposed workflow silently merges them, invents missing claims, exports placeholder files for unavailable renderers and reports PASS without render QA.
requiredBehaviors: reject delivery until one authoritative model is selected by the upstream orchestrator
reject invented content and fake placeholder delivery artifacts
reject PASS without actual render and cross-format QA evidence
forbiddenBehaviors: synthesize competing models inside the delivery layer
simulate renderer success or QA completion
skillAnchors: Der Delivery-Skill synthetisiert sie nicht selbst
keine Ersatzdatei mit falscher Extension erzeugen
ohne simulierte Render-, Delivery- oder Freigabeerfolge
